reviews.title: Great case and price.
reviews.comment: Great little Matx case. Seen a few videos saying it couldn't hold an aio....well it can easily. Love the size and ease of use when building. Being able to remove the side glass it a game changer. 10/10. Went with a blackout look since I don't like rgb.
reviews.author: Jeff

reviews.title: Awesome case for the money
reviews.comment: Awesome looking case. Very well built, handy having mounting posts pre installed
reviews.author: Nick

reviews.title: Decent Case
reviews.comment: It's a Small Case, so cables extensions should not be Recommended, it's relatively easy to build in as long as you cable manage correctly, the fans are actually not bad at all, and the build quality is great for the price point.
